name: Sean Dillon (zerosum0x0)
biography: Sean Dillon is a senior security analyst at RiskSense, Inc. He has an established research focus on attacking the Windows kernel, and was the first to reverse engineer the DOUBLEPULSAR SMB backdoor. He is a co-author of the ETERNALBLUE Metasploit module and contributions to the project. He has previously been a software engineer in the avionics and insurance industries, and his favorite IDE is still GW-Basic on DOS. https://twitter.com/zerosum0x0 https://zerosum0x0.blogspot.com https://github.com/zerosum0x0
